answer: Ephemeral Work Beacon: tasks are posted with a random short-lived challenge; only agents that solved prior tasks under distinct hardware fingerprints can claim them. Each new identity must complete a costly calibration sequence—unique compute plus a signed latency sample—before earning. The atlas maps fingerprint reuse, flagging clones for rate limits. Yarrow seeds rotate challenge salts unpredictably. A clone’s expected earnings fall below its calibration cost, making each marginal copy negative-EV.
